**Finding: deviation (Section 3.4, paragraph p0022) — redline validated and submitted.**

What I found:
- The only inspection right binding us is Section 3.4, allowing HDI's General Manager to inspect the Company's records relating to payment calculations.
- Compliant elements already present: 30 days' prior written notice, exercise during our normal business hours, HDI bears inspection fees, and a narrow scope (records related to payment calculations only).
- Gaps against the preferred position: no frequency cap (unlimited inspections), no express independent-auditor/confidentiality requirement for the inspecting party, and no bar on access to our systems or facilities. Section 8.2 does bind HDI generally as to Company Confidential Information, so the confidentiality fix was a light cross-reference rather than a new regime.

Redline: added a once-per-twelve-month cap, limited the exercise to review of copies (which we may provide off-site), barred access to our systems, networks and facilities, tied the inspecting party to Section 8 confidentiality, and confirmed disclosed information is our Confidential Information — leaving the acceptable notice, business-hours and cost terms untouched. Fallback flagged in the comment (one inspection per year on 15 days' notice) if HDI pushes back.
